# opnsense_bind_dnssec_status (Data Source)

Reads live DNSSEC signing status and registrar-ready SHA-256 DS records for a BIND primary zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_bind_dnssec_status" "public" {
  domain_id = opnsense_bind_primary_domain.public.id
  zone      = opnsense_bind_primary_domain.public.domain_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) UUID of the primary BIND zone.
- `zone` (String) Zone name used to validate the requested UUID.

### Read-Only

- `ds_records` (Set of String) SHA-256 DS records suitable for publication at the registrar.
- `error` (String) Backend error, if any.
- `inline_signing` (Boolean) Whether inline signing is active.
- `keys` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))
- `rndc_status` (Map of String) Parsed `rndc zonestatus` fields.
- `secure` (Boolean) Whether BIND reports the zone as secure.
- `view` (String) BIND view containing the zone.

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String)
- `file` (String)
- `flags` (String)
- `key_tag` (String)
- `role` (String)
